name: PR detail shows the seeded review run, verdict, and findings
description: From PR #482, open the Agent runs tab and confirm the seeded review run renders (verdict 'request changes', 2 findings) in its accordion header. The newest run's accordion is open by default (FindingsTab passes defaultOpen to the first run), so its Critical and Warning counters are visible. Select Warning, verify the Critical card is removed while the Warning card remains, then clear the filter and verify the Critical card returns. Exercises the refactored ReviewRunAccordion / VerdictBanner / FindingsPanel / FindingCard. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
